personal.preferred_title: AWS / PySpark Data Engineer | Glue, Python, SQL & ETL Pipelines

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience and strong hands-on background in AWS data platforms, Python, SQL, PySpark/Spark, AWS Glue, ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation, automation, troubleshooting, and production reporting systems. Experienced building scalable cloud-oriented data workflows using S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Oracle, PySpark, SQL optimization, validation checks, monitoring, and stakeholder-facing analytics. Best aligned to AWS/PySpark/Glue data engineering roles requiring reliable ETL delivery, scalable processing, performance improvement, production support, and cross-functional communication; Terraform is positioned as active learning/working knowledge rather than overstated production ownership.

Optimized SQL queries, Oracle schemas, Redshift-backed workloads, indexes, views, partitioning patterns, and historical retention models for performance and maintainability.
Collaborated with infrastructure, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable data pipelines, reporting layers, dashboards, and support documentation.
